name: Dark Ages -Asa no Konai Basho-
source:
The dark ages where powerful people rule. 
Main character loses his home and family due to the war and gets to live as a bounty hunter, but via friend acquaintance jumps at a chance to train slaves for rich people. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是强者支配一切的黑暗时代。
主人公因战争失去家园与亲人，只得以赏金猎人的身份谋生。后来，他经朋友介绍，得到一个为富人调教奴隶的机会。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
